title: Pump unreachable alarm
symptom: After connecting to a new Dash pod and while preparing the site and inserting, a 'Pump unreachable' alarm sounds within about 2 minutes, even though the user is intentionally in the process of replacing the pod. The alarm is alarming and unwanted during the replacement process.
fix: The thread mentions there is a setting to enable or disable this alert, and a feature request has been opened to add a time parameter to the setting. However, no specific setting name or value is provided.
evidence_quote: There is a setting that lets you enable or disable this alert. I am going to open a feature request suggesting a time parameter to be added to the setting if possible.
